queries: WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS amount_spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT amount_spent, amount_spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(amount_spent) OVER (), 0) AS revenue_share FROM customer_spend), compared AS (SELECT amount_spent, revenue_share, AVG(revenue_share) OVER () AS overall_average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(amount_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(revenue_share) AS average_share, AVG(revenue_share - overall_average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM compared WHERE revenue_share > overall_average_share

WITH customer_totals AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS amount_spent FROM Customer c LEFT JOIN Invoice i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), shares AS (SELECT CustomerId, amount_spent, 1.0 * amount_spent / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(amount_spent) FROM customer_totals), 0) AS share FROM customer_totals), baseline AS (SELECT AVG(share) AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT AVG(s.amount_spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(s.share) AS average_share, AVG(s.share - b.average_share) AS average_share_above_average FROM shares s CROSS JOIN baseline b WHERE s.share > b.average_share;

WITH customer_spend AS (SELECT c.CustomerId, COALESCE(SUM(i.Total), 0) AS spent FROM Customer AS c LEFT JOIN Invoice AS i ON i.CustomerId = c.CustomerId GROUP BY c.CustomerId), benchmark AS (SELECT SUM(spent) AS revenue, 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS average_share FROM customer_spend), qualifying AS (SELECT cs.spent, cs.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.revenue, 0) AS share, b.average_share FROM customer_spend AS cs CROSS JOIN benchmark AS b WHERE cs.spent * 1.0 / NULLIF(b.revenue, 0) > b.average_share) SELECT AVG(spent) AS average_amount_spent, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess_share FROM qualifying;
